title: kri-compliant Salt state (parsed)
$comment: Validates the STRUCTURE of a parsed salt state (YAML -> JSON): a mapping of state-id -> declaration. Content-level rules (forbidden cmd.run/cmd.shell/cmd.powershell, dangerous-pattern regexes, 64KiB cap) are NOT expressible in JSON Schema and are enforced by validate_artifact / docs/platform/contract/contract.json. Passing this schema is necessary but not sufficient for compliance.

additionalProperties.title: state declaration
additionalProperties.$comment: Keys are state functions like 'pkg.installed' / 'service.running'; values are lists of argument mappings. cmd.run/cmd.shell/cmd.powershell are forbidden (enforced by validate_artifact).
